name: Uravan Ballpark
evidence: Esri z19 0.235 m/px: three site shelters on the SW bank 10-15 m from water, thin grass fringe, open dirt drivable to them, no treeline. rimrocker.org photos: shelter with table/grill/ring on the bank, river beyond; RVs on the dirt. San Miguel channel 15-20 m on four transects, under 30 m, so creekside. No per-site map exists.

name: West Dolores
evidence: rec.gov 233251 pad coords on NAIP 0.22 m/px: RV on 04E ~19 m from the channel, patchy conifers and open bank between; 03E farther. Channel ~10-15 m, under 30 m, so not riverfront. Catalog has no Proximity to Water tags. Nine official site photos show no water; shrubs behind 08, 09, 16. Eight FCFS sites unplotted.

name: Weston Pass
evidence: Esri z18 0.46 m/px: stream is a 1-3 m channel in a 50-100 m willow flat; campground road and visible spurs ~40-60 m away behind forest edge and willow; pads under canopy not legible. FS page silent on the creek; rec.gov 10165736 is one placeholder site, no per-site map; no site photos found. Defaults down; no creek-view value. NAIP timed out.

name: Willow Creek
evidence: Esri z19 + NAIP 0.22 m/px: north-arc spurs end ~48-55 m from the beach edge with lodgepole and logs between; spur north of the toilet has pads ~28-38 m out behind dense shrubs; west loop sites 80-100 m across sage with the road between. rec.gov group G01 (tent-only, does not count) photo shows the lake over shrubs. At pool level, not below the dam. No site map found.

name: Wolcott (Eagle River, BLM)
evidence: Esri z19 + NAIP: Eagle River ~24-47 m, river by size. BLM on-site sign map separates Boat Ramp lot (day use, does not count) from Camping Area along the access road. Most pads inland of the road; closest north-side pad ~16 m from water behind a continuous 10-20 m willow band. Visitor photos show boulder-edged pads with shrub screen, no pad at open water.
